title: Release version 0.3.0
body:
## Version Release v0.3.0

- [x] Create new changeset for unreleased features (plugin-object and objectql updates)
- [x] Run changeset version to bump package versions
- [x] Update CHANGELOG.md to move unreleased changes to new version
- [x] Verify all package.json files are updated correctly
- [x] Build all packages to ensure no errors
- [x] Commit version bump changes
- [x] **Unify all package versions to 0.3.0 for consistent versioning**

### Unified Versions

All packages in the monorepo are now at version **0.3.0**:
- `@object-ui/types`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/core`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/react`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/components`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/designer`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/cli`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/data-objectql`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/plugin-charts`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/plugin-editor`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/plugin-object`: 0.3.0
- `@object-ui/runner`: 0.3.0
- `object-ui` (vscode-extension): 0.3.0

### Key Features in v0.3.0

- **ObjectTable**: Auto-generates data tables from ObjectQL object schemas
- **ObjectForm**: Auto-generates forms with create/edit/view modes from ObjectQL schemas
- **ObjectQL SDK**: Updated from ^1.8.3 to ^1.9.1 for improved metadata API support
- **Unified Versioning**: All packages now share the same version number for easier management
